summary: Global Ship Lease filed a Form 6-K announcing it agreed to newbuilding contracts for five containerships for an aggregate purchase price of ~$413 million, with deliveries scheduled in 2029. The vessels are pre-chartered on multi-year terms with TEU-weighted average firm charter of 8.1 years, expected to generate ~$362 million in aggregate Adjusted EBITDA. The orderbook including prior orders totals 15 ships. This is a routine capital expenditure/operational update — not an acquisition of a business, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or other special situation. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of a contractual order.
